title: WebsiteShareCreateRequest
description: website.share-create-request@1: the body of website.share.create (POST /api/v1/shares). The caller names one DNS label, the protocol, the local target and the policy; the project scope comes from the token, never from this body. Connect returns only website.share@1; CON-5 defines a separate authenticated exchange for the one-time tunnel token.

name.description: The requested single label under openvibe.website. A taken or reserved label is refused; the UI may suggest name-2 rather than changing it silently.

local_target.description: The local port the Link exposes, e.g. 127.0.0.1:3000; never an arbitrary internet host.

policy.description: The policy to enforce. An id binds an existing owner-checked policy; without one, Connect creates it. Server-owned fields are refused in this caller body. Credential and link secrets are configured separately.

node_id.description: Optional: bind the share to this Node principal now. Omit to bind it when the first tunnel connects.

region.description: Optional preferred edge region; placement may ignore it when capacity or policy requires.
